intent.title: Use a locally paired assistant through the real command catalogue
steps: Open Assistant and configure the model and encrypted service key.
Pair Companion, select this editor session and send text or a reference image.
Observe streamed results, cancel or undo the complete turn.
expected: Every document edit uses the real validated commands and one grouped undo entry.
Keys stay outside project state and exports.
MCP tools target only the explicitly selected editor, with authenticated local transport.
